name: add_delivery_location
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Add a new delivery address to the user's profile.

set_as_default.description: If True, mark this as the default delivery address. Defaults to False.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated profile.

name: add_favorite_restaurant
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Add a restaurant to the user's list of favorite restaurants.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: favorites (List[str] — current list of favorited restaurant IDs).

name: add_dash_payment
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Add a new credit or debit card as a payment method.

card_number.description: Full card number; only the last 4 digits are stored.

cvv.description: Card security code (3 or 4 digits); not stored.

billing_name.description: Cardholder name as it appears on the card.

properties.description: str: The new method_id assigned to this payment method.

name: cancel_dash
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Cancel an active order. A small fee applies if the restaurant has already started preparing.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: order_id (str), canceled (bool — False if already in terminal state), fee (float — cancellation fee in dollars, 0.0 if free).

name: get_promos
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Retrieve all available promotional offers and indicate which are in the user's wallet.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Offers, each with: offer_id (str), discount (float — dollar amount off), min_order (float), dashpass (bool — DashPass membership required to use), in_wallet (bool — True if this offer is already in your promo wallet).

name: get_dashpass_status
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Retrieve DashPass membership status and associated benefits.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]:

dashpass.description: Whether the user has an active DashPass subscription.

benefits.description: Active benefit descriptions (empty list if no membership).

name: get_favorite_restaurants
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Retrieve summaries for all favorited restaurants.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Restaurant summaries, each with: restaurant_id (str), name (str), category (str), rating (float), is_open (bool). Returns an empty list if the user has no favorites.

name: get_store_menu
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Retrieve the full menu for a restaurant.

restaurant_id.description: The restaurant whose menu to fetch.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Menu items, each with: item_id (str), name (str), category (str), price (float), options (List[Dict] — selectable add-ons or variants), available (bool).

name: get_dash
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Retrieve full details for a specific order.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: order_id (str), restaurant_id (str), restaurant_name (str), items (List[Dict]), fees (Dict with delivery_fee/service_fee/tax/tip), total (float), status (str), created_at (str), applied_promo (Dict | None — offer_id and discount), delivery_address (Dict), eta_min (int).

name: get_dash_history
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Retrieve a summary list of all orders, newest first.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Orders sorted by creation time (newest first), each with: order_id (str), restaurant_name (str), total (float), status (str), created_at (str).

name: get_dasher_profile
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Retrieve the current user's profile information.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Profile with fields: name (str), email (str), phone (str), address (List[Dict] — saved delivery addresses), payment_method (List[Dict] — saved payment methods), promo (List[str] — offer_ids in the promo wallet), dashpass (bool — DashPass membership status), favorites (List[str] — favorited restaurant IDs).

name: get_store_details
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Retrieve full details for a restaurant, including a brief menu summary.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: restaurant_id (str), name (str), category (str), rating (float), address (str), is_open (bool), menu (List[Dict] — item_id, name, price for each menu item).

name: list_dash_payments
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: List all payment methods saved to the user's profile.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Payment methods, each with: method_id (str), type (str), last4 (str), expiration_date (str), billing_name (str), is_default (bool).

name: place_dash
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Place a food delivery order directly (no cart required).

restaurant_id.description: The restaurant to order from. Must be open.

items.description: Items to order. Each dict requires: item_id (str), quantity (int >= 1). Optional: selected_options (List), special_instructions (str).

delivery_address_id.description: Address ID from your profile to deliver to.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method ID from your profile to charge.

tip.description: Dasher tip in dollars. Defaults to 0.0.

offer_id.description: Offer ID from your promo wallet to apply.

properties.description: str: The new order_id. The order begins in "preparing" status.

name: rate_dash
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Submit a rating and optional comment for a completed order.

rating.description: Overall food satisfaction score from 1 (worst) to 5 (best).

comment.description: Free-text review. Defaults to empty string.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated order object including the submitted rating.

name: remove_delivery_location
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Remove a saved delivery address from the user's profile.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated profile.

name: remove_favorite_restaurant
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Remove a restaurant from the user's list of favorite restaurants.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: favorites (List[str] — updated list of favorited restaurant IDs).

name: reorder
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Quickly re-place a past order with the same items at the same restaurant.

delivery_address_id.description: Address ID from your profile for this new delivery.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method ID from your profile to charge.

tip.description: Dasher tip in dollars. Defaults to 0.0.

properties.description: str: The new order_id for the repeated order.

name: search_stores
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Search for restaurants by name or category.

query.description: Text matched against restaurant name. Empty string matches all.

open_only.description: If True, return only currently open restaurants. Defaults to False.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Matching restaurants, each with: restaurant_id (str), name (str), category (str), rating (float), address (str), is_open (bool).

name: set_primary_delivery_location
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Mark an address as the default delivery address.

address_id.description: The address to set as default.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated profile.

name: set_primary_dash_payment
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Mark a payment method as the default for future orders.

method_id.description: The payment method to mark as default.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Updated list of all payment methods.

name: track_dash
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Get real-time delivery tracking for an order.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: order_id (str), courier_name (str), status (str), eta_min (int), current_stage (str — one of: restaurant_preparing / dasher_assigned / dasher_picking_up / en_route / delivered / canceled).

name: update_dasher_profile
description: This tool belongs to the DoorDash food delivery system, which allows users to browse restaurants, view menus, place and track food delivery orders, manage their profile and payment methods, apply promotional offers, reorder past meals, and manage favorite restaurants. Tool description: Update basic profile fields for the current user.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated profile.
